eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 2:19 PM on JAN 3, 2021 Effective until 12:19 AM JAN 4, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Maricopa County Sheriff's Office is looking for a Male,  Ian Lawrence Paul,  who is five foot eight,  weighs one hundred and thirty five pounds, has brown hair and eyes, last seen wearing a white tee shirt, tan button up shirt and kah ki shorts.  On foot walking away from the area of 18400 block of west Sanna Street in Waddell Arizona.  He suffers from autism and severe anxiety disorder. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
